mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS refundId, r.order_id AS orderId, r.customer_id AS customerId, o.settlement_customer_id AS settlementCustomerId, o.seller_id AS sellerId, r.refund_amount AS amount, r.status, r.completed_at AS completedAt FROM order_refund r JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND o.customer_id = r.customer_id AND o.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.id = #{refundId} AND r.deleted = FALSE
SELECT id FROM sales_order WHERE id = #{orderId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM order_refund WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_refund r WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} AND r.deleted = FALSE AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_payment p WHERE p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = r.id AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_refund p WHERE p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = r.id AND p.deleted = FALSE)))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_intent i WHERE i.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND i.source_id = #{orderId} AND i.deleted = FALSE AND i.status IN ('CREATED', 'PENDING'))
mapper.sql: FROM customer_balance_movement m JOIN order_refund r ON m.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND m.source_id = r.id JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN customer_balance_account a ON a.id = m.account_id AND a.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} AND m.deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AND (r.deleted = TRUE OR o.deleted = TRUE OR r.status != 'COMPLETED' OR m.type != 'REFUND' OR m.direction != 'CREDIT' OR m.customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.customer_id OR r.customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.customer_id OR m.settlement_customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.settlement_customer_id OR a.settlement_customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.settlement_customer_id OR m.amount IS DISTINCT FROM r.refund_amount OR m.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM r.completed_at))
